title.narrative: Office of the Public Prosecutor Strengthening and Modernization Program
Programa de Fortalecimiento y Modernizacin del Ministerio Pblico

description.narrative: Aumentar la eficacia del Ministerio Pblico para contribuir a la reduccin de la impunidad en Guatemala. El objetivo se lograr a travs de: (i) aumentar la eficiencia en el procesamiento de denuncias y casos; (ii) aumentar la calidad de las solicitudes de acusacin presentadas a los jueces; y (iii) disminuir tiempos de respuesta interna y para atencin al ciudadano

To enhance the efficiency of the Office of the Public Prosecutor (MP) in order to help reduce impunity in Guatemala. This objective will be achieved by: (i) boosting efficiency in the processing of complaints and cases; (ii) increasing the quality of motions for indictment submitted to judges; and (iii) reducing internal response times and speeding assistance to the public.
